_comment: Copy to salary_sheets.json. Keys: a team id, a unique part of a team name, or "me". Values: a Google Sheets URL (shared 'anyone with the link can view'; add #gid=... for a tab other than the first) or a CSV path, or an object with column hints for sheets the parser can't read on its own. "owner": "app" makes the app the source of truth for that team: its sheet is adopted once, then only written to (see README).
